article_title: I'm a wildlife cameraman but 'special' rare sightings can still take me by surprise

tasks.prompt: Why was the humpback whale sighting especially memorable for wildlife cameraman Dan Abbot?
options: It happened unexpectedly during a blue shark trip, despite his previous whale experience.
It was the first whale ever recorded anywhere in Welsh waters.
It occurred beside the harbour before the boat left shore.
It proved that humpbacks now live permanently in the Celtic Deep.
tasks.correct_answer: It happened unexpectedly during a blue shark trip, despite his previous whale experience.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אבוט כבר ראה לווייתנים גדולי־סנפיר בעבר, אך הפעם המפגש הלא מתוכנן במהלך טיול כרישים הפך אותו למיוחד במיוחד.

tasks.prompt: What was the group originally scheduled to do on 25 September?
options: Track fin whales near the Pembrokeshire coast
Film a documentary from a nearby beach
Snorkel with blue sharks offshore
Count dolphins for Sea Trust
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הקבוצה יצאה לטיול שנקבע מראש לשנורקלינג עם כרישים כחולים, כ־25–30 מייל מהחוף.

tasks.prompt: In context, what does “suspected” mean when Abbot first considered what kind of whale it was?
options: Proved beyond doubt
Thought was possible before confirming
Reported to the authorities
Had photographed previously
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בתחילה אבוט חשב שאולי מדובר בלווייתן מינקי או סנפיר, לפני שאסף סימני זיהוי נוספים.

tasks.prompt: Which combination helped Abbot identify the animal as a humpback whale?
options: A straight dorsal fin and no visible tail
A blue-grey head and a very small blow
Two calves swimming beside the boat
A white pectoral fin, a lifted tail and barnacles near the head
tasks.correct_answer: A white pectoral fin, a lifted tail and barnacles near the head
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסנפיר החזי הלבן, הרמת הזנב והבלוטים בחזית הראש היו סימני הזיהוי שתיאר אבוט.

tasks.prompt: Why did the guests' excitement rise even further when the whale appeared?
options: They had already enjoyed several hours of successful wildlife sightings.
They had been told that no sharks would be seen that day.
They were returning after a disappointing ten-minute trip.
They expected the whale to follow the boat back to harbour.
tasks.correct_answer: They had already enjoyed several hours of successful wildlife sightings.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האורחים כבר היו במצב רוח מרומם אחרי טיול של ארבע שעות עם כרישים וחיות נוספות, ולכן ההפתעה הוסיפה לשיא.

tasks.prompt: What does “not unheard of” mean in Lloyd Nelmes's description of humpback sightings in the area?
options: They have never been recorded.
They happen every week.
They are rare, but they do sometimes occur.
They are heard but usually not seen.
tasks.correct_answer: They are rare, but they do sometimes occur.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נלמס אמר שהמראות נדירים אך אינם חסרי תקדים, ומתרחשים בערך אחת לשנתיים או שלוש.

tasks.prompt: Give two examples of feeding wildlife mentioned in or near the Celtic Deep around the sighting.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני פרטים נכונים, כגון טונה כחולת־סנפיר, דולפינים, סולות או שישה לווייתני סנפיר שנראו ביום הקודם.
expected_points: Bluefin tuna, dolphins and gannets were feeding during the trip.
The previous day, six fin whales and more than 1,000 dolphins were seen amid intense feeding activity.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the group noticed and then identified the humpback whale.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את נשיפת הלווייתן שזוהתה בידי אורח, את ההשערה הראשונית ואת סימני הזיהוי שהובילו למסקנה.
expected_points: A guest first noticed the whale's blow in the distance.
Abbot initially considered more common minke or fin whales.
The white pectoral fin, raised tail and head barnacles indicated a humpback.

tasks.prompt: What possible explanation does the article give for humpback sightings becoming more common in Welsh waters?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין שפע המזון באזור לבין האפשרות של עלייה בתצפיות, תוך הצגה כהסבר אפשרי ולא כעובדה מוכחת.
expected_points: Nelmes suggested that abundant food may attract humpbacks to the area.
The article supports this possibility with descriptions of intense feeding by several marine species.

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining how surprise can make an experienced wildlife encounter feel special. Use details from Abbot's experience.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח טענה ברורה, להשתמש בשני פרטים מהכתבה ולהסביר כיצד חוסר התכנון השפיע על תגובתו של אבוט.
expected_points: Abbot had seen humpbacks before and normally remained calm around wildlife.
This whale appeared on an unrelated shark trip, making the encounter unexpected.
His quiet reaction and the guests' excitement show how surprise increased its emotional impact.
